# Screeps Store

> > Official store for Screeps programming games where you code your strategy in JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, C#, or Kotlin to compete in MMO and PvP environments.

Screeps offers two distinct game modes: World (a persistent MMO RTS sandbox) and Arena (competitive 1v1 PvP battles). Players write code to control their units in real-time strategy gameplay, making it a unique platform for programmers to compete and learn.

## Game Modes

- [Screeps - online strategy game for programmers](https://store.screeps.com/): Homepage for Screeps programming games: World (MMO) and Arena (PvP)
- [Screeps: World](https://store.screeps.com/world): Screeps: World product page - persistent MMO RTS sandbox with JavaScript
- [Screeps: Arena](https://store.screeps.com/arena): Screeps: Arena product page - 1v1 PvP strategy game using JavaScript

## Store & Items

- [Item Shop - Screeps](https://world.store.screeps.com/): In-game item shop for CPU unlocks, pixels, access keys, and promo codes

## Optional

- [Screeps Creator Program](https://store.screeps.com/creators): Affiliate program offering 30% revenue share for content creators
